【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, put this card into your memory.
【AUTO】 【CXCOMBO】 Memory When "All Together in the Pool" is placed on your climax area, if your level is 2 or higher, and this card is in your memory, you may put this card on an open position of your stage.

cards.name: "Avant-garde HISTORY" Yukina Minato
cards.text:
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, choose 1 character in your opponent's center stage, and that character gets -1000 power until end of turn.
【AUTO】 [Return 2 《Roselia》 characters from your waiting room to your deck & Shuffle your deck] When this card is placed on the stage from your hand, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 of your 《Roselia》 characters, and that character gets the following ability until end of turn. "【CONT】 This card's soul does not decrease by side attacking."

cards.name: Live's Finale, Lisa Imai
cards.text:
【CONT】 All 《Roselia》 characters in your hand get "【ACT】 【COUNTER】 Backup 2500, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room]".
【ACT】 [(1) 【REST】 this card] Look at up to 2 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 level 1 or higher card from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and put the rest into your waiting room. (Climax are regarded as level 0)
